name: What is the process for getting an inherited home valuation with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting an inherited home valuation with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for obtaining an inherited home valuation with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution typically begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and the property details. We then conduct a thorough comparative market analysis (CMA) or, if required, assist in arranging a formal appraisal. This involves evaluating recent sales of similar properties, current market trends in your area (e.g., Aventura, Coral Gables, Fort Lauderdale), and the condition of the inherited home. We present you with a comprehensive report to help you make informed decisions, whether for probate, tax planning, or sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our valuation process involves an initial consultation, followed by a comparative market analysis or appraisal arrangement, evaluating local market trends and property specifics to provide a comprehensive report.
